nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=30 beats='It is the first morning of the holiday week and Miri has the big job of looking after the three school hens; she carries the feed bucket down the dewy path to the coop, calling good morning to Clover, Buttercup, and little Pip'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='Clover and Buttercup hop down from the roost for breakfast, but Pip, the smallest hen, is nowhere; the door was latched all night, yet a cool draft slips in low along the coop wall, something rattles out toward the garden shed, and tiny gray feathers dot the grass toward the woodpile'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Inside the coop the straw is warm and the thin cool draft comes from somewhere low in the back wall'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='The draft comes from a loose board low in the coop wall that wobbles when Miri touches it, and the middle nesting box straw is pressed into a warm empty bowl; Pip squeezed out somewhere, but Miri could also step back outside and try a different clue'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='The board swings aside to show a hen-sized squeeze-hole leading straight into the yard next door'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='Through the hole Miri sees the tidy backyard of Mrs. Otto, with wind chimes and a watering can by the porch; one soft cluck floats across the grass, but Miri cannot tell if it came from near the house or from the shadowy gap under the porch step'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=60 beats='Mrs. Otto comes out in garden gloves and joins the hunt with a stepstool and a tin of oats; behind the watering can they find Pip, dusty but unhurt, crouched against the porch and ready to dart; Mrs. Otto shakes oats into her palm while Miri creeps closer, hardly breathing'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Mrs. Otto lifts Pip gently over the fence and into the arms of Miri, where the little hen settles like a warm loaf; back in the coop Clover and Buttercup fuss a noisy greeting; before breakfast is over Miri wedges a brick against the loose board so the adventure stays a one-time thing'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='In the shadowy spot where Pip was hiding, Miri finds a small brown egg, still warm; the little hen made herself a secret nest next door; Miri carries hen and egg carefully home through the gate, and Mrs. Otto promises to help board up the squeeze-hole after lunch'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Miri kneels at the cool dark gap under the porch step and two small eyes blink back at her'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=52 beats='There sits Pip in a snug hollow of straw under the porch; she steps onto the offered palm of corn with a proud cluck; Miri carries her home and later she and Mrs. Otto block the gap together with a flowerpot'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Miri follows the wire fence past the bean poles, dew soaking her sneakers, toward the rattling sound'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='Low in the wire Miri finds a bent gap with gray fluff caught on the sharp ends; the tool shed door stands open a crack with a rustle inside, the flattened grass points away toward the woodpile, and the coop is only a short jog back if this trail goes cold'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Among the seed sacks a corn sack has tipped over, and tiny three-toed prints mark the dust'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=50 beats='Miri fills the grain scoop and gives it a practice shake; the rattle sounds exactly like breakfast time, the sound that always brings the hens running; the tiny prints lead out the door toward the grass, but the rustle behind the seed sacks comes again'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=60 beats='Miri lays a dotted line of corn kernels across the grass and hides behind the wheelbarrow; out from the shadows struts Pip, snapping up kernels one by one along the line; the proud little parade heads straight for Miri, who waits with the last kernel in her palm, one step from reach'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Pip pecks the last kernel right from the palm of Miri and lets herself be scooped up at last; Miri carries her back to the coop where Clover and Buttercup fuss and flap a welcome; from that morning on, the rattling grain scoop is the official school hen alarm'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=62 beats='Miri walks backward, shaking the scoop softly, and Pip follows the sound all the way across the garden and through the pop-door on her own; that night Miri counts three hens side by side on the roost and latches the coop door with a happy sigh'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=16 beats='Miri lifts the sacks one by one and finds a warm hollow of straw where something shifts'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=52 beats='There is Pip, blinking up from a cozy nest on the soft sack pile where she spent the whole night; she shakes the dust off her feathers and rides home in the crook of Miri elbow, and the shed door gets shut tight'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=15 beats='A dotted line of tiny gray feathers crosses the grass toward the stacked woodpile'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=40 beats='A soft scritch-scratch comes from low in the logs and stops whenever Miri talks; at the woodpile corner the berry bushes tremble, and if both clues fizzle the coop is close enough to run back for a new idea'>>

choices.label: Run back for a new idea

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=55 beats='Miri waits statue-still and a small gray head pokes out of a gap between the bottom logs; it is Pip, one hop away but ready to bolt back into the dark if anything moves too fast; Miri thinks of her two gentlest tricks'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=62 beats='Slow as honey, Miri slides one hand along the bottom log and lifts Pip out of the gap; the little hen grumbles once, then tucks her head under the chin of Miri for the whole walk back to the coop, where Clover and Buttercup are waiting'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='Pip will not be hurried, so Miri sets a dish of corn by the logs, props the pop-door open, and waits quietly by the coop; when the sky turns pink Pip walks herself home and hops onto the roost beside Clover and Buttercup, and Miri latches the door'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=15 beats='Under the berry bushes the leaves tremble and a proud crooning sound floats out, the sound a hen makes when she thinks she is hidden'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=45 beats='Pip steps into a patch of light in the middle of a glorious dust bath, flipping dirt over her wings like confetti; she shakes herself and looks right at Miri, one hop away and ready to bolt'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='Moving slow as a statue, Miri scoops Pip up mid-shake and gets a face full of dust for her trouble; she laughs, brushes off the little hen, and carries her home to Clover and Buttercup, already planning a proper dust box inside the run for the rest of the holiday'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=62 beats='Miri grabs too fast and Pip skitters deep into the bushes where no arm can reach; the sky is already going pink, so Miri leaves a dish of corn and fresh water by the berry bushes and promises out loud to come back first thing tomorrow'>>
